documents.reason: Families with toddlers still get spaces by the exit so others can stay seated. The cash and picnic options, permission before publicizing the title, afternoon weather decision and original announcement channel all survive. The proposed door test illustrates the existing tradeoff: the original shade leaves the route bright, and the rewrite's screen lets people see their way to the toilets. The accessibility, sightline, sound, welcome and equipment-return arrangements retain their purposes and actors.

The owner's account still precedes opening the item because bench inspection can hide an intermittent fault. Battery leaks are still flagged at intake for the lead, and the qualified volunteer still documents final checks before release. The rewrite calls the lead the person 'leading the morning', an incidental time detail. The invitation, seating, bench and lamp arrangements, guided last stitches, handover note and pickup trial retain their rationales. 'For the last quarter hour' preserves the change to advice or later bookings so jobs are not left in pieces.

The original sends the seed-saving reminder 'before harvest', so gardeners know which plants to leave standing before they start picking. The rewrite requires it only 'before they pick their last pods for dinner'. It could arrive after they have harvested the plants they should have kept. The reminder still aims to yield mature seed, but the timing that protects that outcome is weaker.

The original ties the crate reconciliation to 'the last collection' when the kitchen reopens, without specifying how long the arrangement runs. The rewrite adds 'when the six weeks are up'. It keeps the final pickup and delivery record but gives staff a specific end date unsupported by the source. The morning attendance cutoff and the trained receiver's check before serving retain their original timing.

The crescent or quarter Moon still has to clear the local buildings during the gathering. 'Before dusk' becomes 'before the daylight goes' for aligning the finder, so the volunteer can recover a bumped target. Return slips still relieve pressure at the eyepiece, and the final question about what visitors can find again still captures learning that telescope counts miss. The cloud notice, accessible approach, focus demonstration, chart alignment, warmth, voice level and lunar sketch all keep their original uses.

The source justifies a typeable starting URL because 'not everyone wants to install an app'. The rewrite states 'Few people want a new app', turning a claim about the existence of reluctant visitors into a prevalence claim about most visitors. The practical provision survives. Other dependencies, including agreement with the speaker before publication, testing at the likely walking hour and giving a dated alternate route, are retained.

The arranger, edition and opening tempo still distinguish versions, and the part transposition and concert key remain separate searches. A recording still needs the creator's agreement and credits. The original check at 'opposite ends of the loan' becomes the borrower checking on the way out and the volunteer checking on return. The public availability and private contact records, named reservations, removable markings, stand trial and repair status all retain their functions.

Because a child can reach 'whatever is on the bottom shelf', the original says to 'Reserve that space for boxed children's puzzles'. The rewrite says 'Put boxed children's sets at the bottom'. This preserves their location and visible age guidance but permits other sets within reach on the same shelf. The box code still links home reports, recovered pieces and the noticeboard photograph.
